benchmark: Harvey Legal Agent Benchmark (LAB), pinned public commit
primary_endpoint: Harvey criterion all-pass per unique task

pass_thresholds.note: all_pass_delta_min is unused: task all-pass was degenerate (0 for both arms) in Gate 20. Replaced by rule task_wins_ge_losses (tasks where v0.7 criterion-pass beats control >= tasks where it loses).

strong_evidence_rule: Paired task bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 for criterion-pass delta; reported separately and not required for pilot PASS.
interpretation: Pass = held-out pilot efficacy for v0.7 on 20 unseen tasks; same-model judge; not deployment certification.
selection_rule: Same rule as Gate 21 (analyze-/assess- 14 + compare- 6; seeded shuffle 22022/22023; max 2 per practice area) but excluding all 40 tasks used in Gates 20 and 21.
primary_goal: Test whether v0.8 (v0.7 + specificity rule, use-full-cap, completeness sweep with spare actions, no-blocking stop rule) improves Harvey criterion pass over control on previously unused tasks.
run_integrity_rule: As Gate 21: each answer checked against its own task documents; runs with no usable output (no file) re-run once; runner scratch dirs unique per run. Runs labelled blocked that contain a substantive memo are judged as written.
development_data: v0.8 designed from aggregate Gate 21 diagnostics only (failure-type counts, word and action usage, blocked-label finding); no rubric text or task content used.
secondary_reporting: Also report criterion-pass delta against Gate 21's v0.7 delta (+3.6 pts) descriptively; no formal v0.8 vs v0.7 test (different task batches).
